hard_checks.criterion: Only vehicle.gd and view.gd change; original track, truck, effects, inputs intact.
Measured physical speed reduces steering gain; smooth bounded response to alternating input. Exported drive_force,low_speed_steering,high_speed_steering,steering_response affect real functions.
Actual Input starts vehicle and advances >2m within 2 seconds; S first decays positive throttle then becomes negative; coast exponential decay is monotonic.
Measured speed causes lookahead and zoom; speed step has no immediate jump and each frame interpolates; slow speed smoothly returns toward near position.

human_checks: Human compares low/high speed corner feel and forward-road visibility.
limits: Developer implementation and scripted verification; root separately reviews. Test setup injection is labeled, never claimed human play.
